issuer: Central Civil Pension Disbursing Agency, Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare, New Delhi
summary: You must submit your yearly Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) before November 30, 2025 so that your monthly pension continues without pause.

actions.task: Submit Annual Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) online or at bank/post office

deadline.quote: Absolute final deadline for all pensioners: 2025-11-30

actions.why_it_matters: Prevent stoppage of monthly pension payment from December 2025 onwards

documents_needed: Active mobile phone for receiving OTP
if_ignored: Pension payment for the month of December 2025 onwards will be stopped until subsequent verification.
